verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server that lets an AI agent work inside the workspace. Through it an agent can list audits and evidence requests and add comments, attachments and status updates. That gives a programmatic surface automation could drive, but it is framed as an interactive assistant integration, not as headless or CI execution. Missing for 10: a documented public API or CLI, non-interactive or service-account authentication for CI, CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
